snippet.description:
What will it take to make healthcare in the US more affordable — and where could Democrats and Republicans actually agree?

In a collaboration with News Not Noise, founder Jessica Yellin joins Vox senior correspondent Dylan Scott to discuss Democrats’ healthcare agenda following their big blue wave. They cover  the obstacles to reversing Medicaid cuts, and potential bipartisan action on prescription drug prices, Medicare payments, and surprise medical bills.
